instruction: Can you replace vim with firefox in the favorite applications?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires replacing vim with firefox in favorite apps. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [thunderbird, firefox, chrome]. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: replacing vim with firefox in favorite apps
Getter extracts the right state: uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps' to retrieve current favorite apps list
Metric logic is correct: parses the apps string, compares with expected list using set comparison (order-independent)
Expected values are semantically correct: ['thunderbird.desktop', 'firefox.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop'] matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: checks all three apps are present (thunderbird, firefox, chrome) and vim is absent
No postconfig needed: reading system state directly, not UI-dependent
Data flow is correct: command output -> string parsing -> set comparison -> binary result
